pages.text: $(bold)Debug Terminal$()$(br2)Operators can right-click the terminal to edit parameters or use the control page for debug mode, cooldown override, hit notifications and log snapshots. Shift-right-click requests a snapshot directly. CSV files are read and written on the server.
$(bold)Hit Notifications$()$(br2)The control page toggles hit notifications. When on, weapon hits show damage numbers and a hit marker; when off, nothing is shown.
$(bold)Cooldown Override$()$(br2)The control page toggles a server-side cooldown override that compresses weapon cooldowns to test-friendly values. Intended for development verification.
